title: Strawberries first, wine grapes second
text: In 2024, for the fourth year in a row, the farm products of San Luis Obispo County were worth more than a billion dollars. Strawberries were the most valuable crop, wine grapes came second, and cattle and calves third. It was a hard year for wine grapes: their value fell 40 percent, with sales down for every variety.

s3.title: Annual Crop Report 2024, County of San Luis Obispo
s3.publisher: County of San Luis Obispo, Department of Agriculture/Weights and Measures
s3.table: San Luis Obispo County Annual Crop Report 2024, Top 10 Crops table
s3.quote: The overall crop value decreased by 8% to $1,015,871,000 compared to that of 2023. Despite the decrease, this is the fourth consecutive year where overall commodity values exceeded the billion-dollar mark ... 1 Strawberries $242,370,000 ... 2 Wine Grapes all $194,981,000 ... 3 Cattle and Calves $65,531,000 ... winegrapes experienced a decline from that of previous years, with a drop in gross value of 40% across all varietals.
